testCases.title: AC1 - A signed-in user with an item in the cart can complete an order and sees a confirmation.
preconditions: The standard user is signed in unless the case is about signing in
steps: Carry out the behaviour described by AC1: A signed-in user with an item in the cart can complete an order and sees a confirmation.
expected: A signed-in user with an item in the cart can complete an order and sees a confirmation.

expected: Checkout is rejected with an error message when the first name is empty.
